snippet.title: Meowgic | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
YapYap X Cats vibes. A co-op fantasy adventure where your voice is magic. Play as cat wizards, cast spells by shouting into your mic, explore fairy-tale worlds, fight monsters, and return to your hot air baloon loaded with loot.
